reading.title: Bumble shares soar after report dating firm in $1bn takeover talks
reading.summary: The jump pushed Bumble's stock market valuation to more than $580m but that is still far below their peak of more than $14bn.

news.title: Documents falsified to evade tax on Abramovich's wealth, BBC finds
news.summary: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.
